versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11001 The Operating System module shall support OS-Applications which are a configurable selection of Trusted Functions, Task s, ISR s, Alarm s, ScheduleTable s, Counter s, hooks (for startup, error and shutdown).
